## Background

My background combines business and analytics in an interesting way. My
undergraduate degree was in Finance at the University of Warwick, and I
started out in traditional finance, with work experience in private equity,
M&A, and restructuring. Over time, though, I got increasingly pulled toward
the quantitative and technical side of decision-making, actually figuring
out what the data said rather than just presenting it. That pull is what
brought me to an MSc in Business Analytics & AI at Imperial College London,
an internship at leading digital and AI-focused consultancy OMMAX, and now
to scaling new products from the ground up at Revolut New Bets.

The projects on this site largely illustrate what I enjoy about ML and
data science. Asking difficult questions, making bold hypotheses, and
gaining slightly better understanding of the world around us, datapoint by
datapoint.

## What I work with

- **Domains**: time series forecasting, NLP & embeddings, portfolio optimization, causal inference, marketing mix & pricing analytics, investment & financial analytics
- **Modelling**: LightGBM, XGBoost, neural networks & deep learning (LSTM, PyTorch, TensorFlow), large language models, Monte Carlo simulation, regression & classification, linear/integer programming
- **Languages & tools**: Python (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, SciPy), R (tidyverse, ggplot2), SQL, Streamlit, Tableau, Excel, Git

See it applied on the [Machine Learning & Data Science](machine-learning.qmd)
